availability_note: Route 134 sail lane; same gate<=68 pool-84 party (Landorus and Tapu Fini are reachable legends). Nothing from Underwater/Seafloor maps.

attempts.note: Incineroar OHKOed T1 by Life Orb Close Combat + Facade before it could Knock Off the Flame Orb; Urshifu left at 24/288 after a Guts Facade.

strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Close Combat into Incineroar (2x) - combined with Facade it was a full-HP OHKO. T2 Close Combat at Urshifu (beaten by Sucker Punch).

strategy_checks.check: Raticate takes its Flame Orb turn then Guts Facade / U-turn pivots
strategy_checks.evidence: Flame Orb burned it end of T1; T3 Guts Facade did 264 to Urshifu. It never U-turned - it attacked or Protected instead, which was correct with a KO on the board.
My party brought no weather; on entry the text 'The effects of the weather disappeared.' printed with no weather active (cosmetic).
I never fired Thunderbolt at Lanturn; the absorber shaped my targeting (Giga Drain/Moonblast instead).

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL - blocked Flutter Mane's Moonblast; Poliwrath still died to Sucker Punch.
REAL - blocked a 2x Thunderbolt on the turn it entered while Raticate's Facade took Urshifu to 24 HP.

ai_defects.board: Lanturn 32/327 alone vs Flutter Mane 164/213 (Spe -2) and Amoonguss 302/364 (Spe -2); Lanturn already outsped both after two Icy Winds
ai_defects.chosen: Icy Wind a third time (48 + 56 chip)
ai_defects.better: Hydro Pump into Flutter Mane or Thunderbolt into Amoonguss - speed control that no longer changes turn order is wasted damage; the first two Icy Winds were fine.

engine_notes.note: Cloud Nine entry printed 'The effects of the weather disappeared.' with no weather set. Cosmetic.

cooler: As a positional anti-weather sailor it is fine, and Poliwrath's Life Orb Close Combat plus a burned Facade gave it real teeth (an OHKO and a near-OHKO). One faint but Urshifu was at 24 HP, so it was a real fight; keep. Against a player who brings no weather the concept simply does not appear, which is inherent to the design and acceptable for a regular trainer between two rain teams.
authored_set_legality: No problem; all four sets played as written.
